title: Wasted money
body: I accidentally hit the pay option and now stuck w this for a year bs ! Gives me the wrong directions and don’t let me change my route when started

title: Tips,OverPriced, and Dark Mode
body: Pretty good app to still be new and upgrading but it’s insane paying $39.99 a year plus tax which is around roughly 40 something dollars there are better apps in quality such as seamless navigation and no lag which this app is not there yet though I do love the different colors and it also needs Dark mode,along with changing address in between routes and add adding extra stops before your final destination and I see the appeal for women and teens there NEEDS TO BE a ONE TIME/LIFETIME SUBSCRIPTION Fee.

title: Cute idea but won’t pay without trial
body: I saw an ad on IG and thought it would be so cute! I wasn’t surprised that it was $10 a month, however I’m surprised there’s no free trial for something so important? It makes me wonder if the makers are not confident in what they made. If someone got a free trial, would they still purchase? It seems the creators don’t want to risk that… yikes- uninstalling (sad I love pink but wtv)

title: Overpriced but good idea
body: The advertisement is for a pink map but the only free option is yellow, and the paid option is $7 a month. When all other maps are free this seems a bit over the top. The price needs to be lowered especially since it’s reoccurring.

title: Needs bug fixes
body: It’s cute and aesthetic. I like the different map colors, however the voices don’t speak at all which is a downer. And I would prefer different routes as well instead of just one, and the fact that there are no reference pictures either to see how places look like also kinda sucks 😭

title: It’s cute.
body: The interface is very cute and the colors are great however, the voices don’t speak! You put in the location you wanna go to when you hit get directions and you start but no one is directing you. I turned my phone all the way up and nothing…

title: Cute but..
body: It’s so cute google map.. but it only has 4 voices I picked the friendly voice and she says “you got this sweetie “ on every direction.. for a long trip it gets kinda annoying she only says you got this. I wish they was just a normal voice .. just say the directions and that’s it.. but I’ll deal with it for the pink maps

title: This is great but I’m confused
body: I am confused about why do we need to pay for this app because it did not show me an option without having to pay for a subscription to use this app for free this is really unfair and the way that it is advertised is misleading and no way, please fix this. Why should I pay for a sub subscription for an app that is already marked as free
